results.title: Salesforce To Acquire Braze For $5.66 Billion - Dataconomy
results.content:
BTIG, Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo, Oppenheimer and Loop Capital cut their ratings on Braze after the agreement. Jefferies said the acquisition “re-energizes Marketing & Commerce Cloud.”

Braze CEO and co-founder Bill Magnuson said the company was built on the belief that marketers and their creativity are a brand’s competitive advantage. He said Braze would continue building as Braze. [...] At $47.50 per share, Salesforce is paying just over six times Braze’s projected annual sales. Evercore ISI analyst Kirk Materne said the size of the premium “seems a bit odd unless it was competitive,” while adding that the deal logic made sense.

Piper Sandler analyst Billy Fitzsimmons downgraded Braze to Neutral and raised his price target to $47.50. He described the acquisition as removing a growing competitor to Salesforce’s Marketing Cloud. Salesforce plans to integrate Braze’s real-time customer-engagement engine and AI decisioning capabilities into Data 360, Customer 360, Agentforce and SIForce. Salesforce describes Braze as optimized for high-volume, real-time business-to-consumer engagement.
